from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys

inputs = Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = json.loads(inputs.read_text())
bindings = set()
for name, wanted in expected.items():
    data = Path(name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == wanted, name
    assert data.endswith(b'\n') and not re.search(rb'[ \t]+$', data, re.M), name
    text = data.decode()
    for path, wanted_hash in re.findall(r'\| `((?:research|LonelyRunner|docs)/[^`]+)` \| `([0-9a-f]{64})` \|', text):
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == wanted_hash, path
        bindings.add((path, wanted_hash))
    for wanted_hash, path in re.findall(r'^([0-9a-f]{64})  ((?:research|LonelyRunner|docs)/[^\n]+)$', text, re.M):
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == wanted_hash, path
        bindings.add((path, wanted_hash))

for author, review in [
    ('research/astra-forward-grid-uniform-supply.md', 'research/astra-forward-grid-uniform-supply-review.md'),
    ('research/astra-forward-grid-revisiting-repair.md', 'research/astra-forward-grid-revisiting-review.md'),
    ('research/astra-cluster-grid-rescue.md', 'research/astra-cluster-grid-rescue-review.md'),
]:
    assert expected[author] in Path(review).read_text(), review

checks = []
for argv in [
    ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'],
    ['git', 'diff', '--check'],
    ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/manage_storage.py'],
]:
    done = subprocess.run(argv, text=True, capture_output=True)
    checks.append(dict(argv=argv, exit_code=done.returncode, stdout=done.stdout, stderr=done.stderr))

record = dict(
    checkpoint='Pass68',
    parent_main='737ac0634c02c21025bcafebacc97c9152f04bf4',
    status='passed' if all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in checks) else 'failed',
    hashes=expected,
    embedded_source_bindings=[dict(path=p, sha256=h) for p,h in sorted(bindings)],
    root_verifier=dict(argv=sys.argv, source_utf8=Path(__file__).read_text(), input_utf8=inputs.read_text()),
    checks=checks,
    mathematical_verification='Three independently reviewed manuscripts plus root full source and review reads. Exact greedy digits, entire invariant-region exclusion and finite budget termination, explicit alternate witness, prime/composite residue construction, and all forward/closed endpoints checked by hand. No mathematical program or numerical search ran.',
    scope='Uniform sufficient separated and unit-plus-narrow-cluster classes, and a counterexample to the specified revisiting algorithm. No arbitrary-tuple reduction, no general grid impossibility, no new Lean declaration or unrestricted LRC resolution.',
    ongoing_work_excluded='Separate general-slow cluster audit remains active and is not an accepted part of this checkpoint.',
    storage='No local Lean cache restored; storage report retained among checks.',
)
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status=record['status'], frozen_files=len(expected), embedded_bindings=len(bindings), checks=checks, receipt=sys.argv[2]), sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if record['status'] == 'passed' else 1)
